The '''1x Hail Com Jammer''' was a model of [[Jammer/Legends|jammer]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was manufactured by [[Miradyne Limited]] and sold for 400.<ref name="AR" />
